decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - That details of materials submitted, a " Redland Grovebury" pantile tile, light brown in colour, pursuant to Condition 7 of approval ref. 00523/101/P1 for the demolition of existing bunglow and erection of a pair of semi detached houses  granted on Appeal 14 January 2004, received 18/8/2005,  be refused because the style  of the  roof  pantile would not serve to  enhance the house or the Conservation Area and is contrary to the Policies ENVB 1.1 (New development) and ENVB 2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the Unitary Development Plan (2003).
description: Following approval for demolition of existing bungalow and erection of two 4 bedroom semi-detached dwellinghouses details submitted pursuant to Condition 7 (materials) of approved appeal decision dated 14/01/2004.
